page: Microsoft Azure M832is_16_v3 is an isolated, memory-optimized instance belonging to the MISHighMemoryv3 family. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors, it delivers 832 dedicated virtual CPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The host environment provides a massive memory footprint of 15,200.0 GB of RAM, equating to 18.27 GB of memory per individual core.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage and features zero GPUs. Storage architectures require external volumes via its Premium Storage capability. Network configurations operate with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because the instance runs as a dedicated and isolated virtual machine, it guarantees full physical host resources without multi-tenant interference or resource contention.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the M832is_16_v3 consolidates extreme computational and memory density into a single virtualized host, eliminating the architectural overhead of distributed clustering for monolithic datasets. It is tailored for large-scale in-memory computing workloads, including mission-critical enterprise databases, massive SAP HANA deployments, and memory-bound transactional data systems.
description: Microsoft Azure M832is_16_v3 is a memory-optimized, host-isolated virtual machine belonging to the MISHighMemoryv3 family. Powered by Intel x86_64 processors running on Microsoft Hyper-V, it features 832 dedicated vCPUs and 15,200.0 GB of RAM, yielding 18.27 GB of memory per core. The server includes no onboard local storage, instead utilizing external Premium Storage, and operates without GPU acceleration or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By dedicating the entire physical host configuration, the instance guarantees resource availability without multi-tenant noisy-neighbor interference. This architecture offers qualitative cost consolidation for extreme resource-scale enterprise applications, avoiding the complexity of distributing datasets across multiple nodes. The M832is_16_v3 is suited for massive in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise data warehousing, mission-critical SAP HANA workloads, and high-capacity transactional processing tiers.
